name: robots/atharva-05__unitree_ros2_sim
title: Unitree GO1 Gazebo simulation
intro: Unitree GO1 Gazebo simulation, adapted from atharva-05/unitree_ros2_sim. It reads `read_scan` and `read_odometry`; runs `publish_cmd_vel`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to /cmd_vel for the move_base state machine. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
